scripts.watch: ng build ui-watchtower --configuration development && ng build ngx-ui-watchtower --watch --configuration development
scripts.test: npm run test:core && ng test --project=ngx-ui-watchtower && npm run test:release
scripts.test:coverage: jest --config projects/ui-watchtower/jest.config.js --coverage --coverageReporters=text-summary --coverageReporters=lcov --json --outputFile=./coverage/ui-watchtower/report.json && ng test --project=ngx-ui-watchtower --coverage --coverage-reporters text-summary --coverage-reporters lcov --json --output-file=./coverage/report.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p projects/ui-watchtower/tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit && tsc -p projects/ui-watchtower/rxjs/tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit && tsc -p projects/ui-watchtower/rum/tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit && tsc -p projects/ui-watchtower/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && tsc -p projects/ui-watchtower/type-tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p projects/ui-watchtower/type-tests/tsconfig.augmented.json && ng build --configuration=production --project=ui-watchtower && tsc -p projects/ngx-ui-watchtower/tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit && tsc -p projects/ngx-ui-watchtower/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && tsc -p projects/ngx-ui-watchtower/rum/tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit && tsc -p projects/ngx-ui-watchtower/rum/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && ngc -p projects/ngx-ui-watchtower/type-tests/tsconfig.json && ngc -p projects/ngx-ui-watchtower/type-tests/tsconfig.augmented.json
